key_insight: An LLM-guided redesign of a magnesium stent reduced a high-percentile bend-strain objective by 32% while navigating about 1,650 CAD parameters within 15 simulations.
engineering_relevance: The approach suggests a route to coordinated component redesign when nonlinear simulations are expensive and manual parameter reduction may constrain optimization.
method: GPT-6 Astra proposed coordinated edits to the stent’s CAD parameters.
Each proposal was built, meshed and simulated with large-deformation plasticity and contact.
Full simulation results informed subsequent design proposals.
evidence_signal: Within the same 15-simulation budget, Tosca improved the objective by about 10%; a separate higher-fidelity deployment check of an earlier LLM design found 14% lower strain and 63% less damage at its most damaged spot.
watch_item: Evidence is limited to one component study, and the higher-fidelity deployment check evaluated an earlier design rather than the final 32%-improved design.
paper_title: AI agents can redesign engineering parts with more than a thousand CAD parameters and nonlinear simulations
